We now have more confirmation that Full Self-Driving (Supervised) in Netherlands is for AI4 vehicles only at this time.

This means that HW3 vehicles in the European Union will either have to wait for the release of V14 Lite or a future hardware upgrade to access FSD.


Xander (@xanderwasserman)

Confirmed: FSD (Supervised) in the Netherlands is only for HW4 at this moment. This has been the general consensus, but good to have it officially confirmed. 

@teslascope @KRoelandschap @Rustavi





— https://nitter.net/xanderwasserman/status/2043596326101819900#m

Full Self-Driving continues to gradually expand to more vehicles in the Netherlands, including those not in early access.

As a reminder, the vehicle must be on a 2026.2 or older update, and geographically positioned within the country limits.

This software update 2026.8.6.1, now going wide, resolves the rear camera delay/blackout issue we reported on previously, which impacted many, but not all Tesla vehicles on 2026.8.6.

We expect vehicles on the prior version will be prioritized initially, as seen in our data.

We’ve observed a majority of Tesla vehicles with 2026.8.6 pending (whether awaiting install or download) have had the update pulled from their vehicles worldwide. This also impacted our own vehicle.

No official insight into the decision at this time can be provided.

As this directly impacts safety, we believe this is the cause of the update being pulled, and may be re-released with fixes.
